name: ac-capital-return-policy
description: How a company returns cash and whether it does so well: buyback programmes and execution mechanics, accelerated share repurchases, dividend policy and sustainability, special and variable dividends, buyback timing against valuation, shareholder yield versus other uses of cash, buyback-funded-by-debt arithmetic, and the written capital-return record. It analyses the mechanics and the arithmetic; it never recommends a security and never predicts a share price. Use when asking "buyback", "share repurchase", "dividend policy", "payout ratio", "special dividend", "accelerated share repurchase", "shareholder yield", "is the dividend safe", "buyback or dividend". Not for scoring management's capital allocation record (ac-equity-research), not for the tax treatment of dividends and buybacks (ac-tax-aware-investing), not for corporate actions adjustment of prices (ac-corporate-actions).
